image_description: A close-up photograph of a bicycle disc brake assembly. The image features a black Shimano Deore hydraulic caliper mounted on the left side, clamping onto a silver metallic rotor with circular ventilation holes. In the background, out of focus, are bicycle spokes and a cassette gear cluster. A black hydraulic hose connects to the top of the caliper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Circular metal rotor (disc), notably larger in diameter than its thickness.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rotor is clearly visible as a thin, circular metal disc. Its diameter is significantly larger than its thickness, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Caliper is cast metal mounted over rotor edge.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The black caliper housing is positioned over the edge of the rotor, consistent with standard disc brake mounting.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rotor is mounted to wheel hub with visible lug bolt pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The center of the wheel (hub) is occluded by the caliper and the angle of the shot; no lug bolts or hub interface are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rotor is ventilated (two plates with cooling fins) or solid.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rotor exhibits a pattern of circular cutouts/holes around the perimeter, which serves as ventilation/weight reduction typical for bicycle rotors.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Brake pads are rectangular friction material blocks pressing against rotor faces.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the pads themselves are internal, the caliper design implies their presence, and the gap between caliper jaws and rotor is consistent with pad placement.
A black tube (hydraulic hose) is clearly visible entering the top port of the caliper body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface shows machined concentric grooves or cross-drilled holes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rotor surface has distinct circular drill holes for ventilation and heat dissipation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface exhibits heat discoloration (blue/brown tint) from use.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rotor appears clean and silver/metallic without significant blueing or brown rust stains indicative of heavy heat cycling or corrosion.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Caliper is cast aluminum or iron.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The caliper has the matte black finish and molded shape characteristic of cast aluminum alloy used in bicycle components.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomy class and distinguish it from similar mechanical parts like gears or pulleys.
To verify the physical separation between the caliper and rotor and ensure no melting artifacts at the contact points.
To audit the legibility and correctness of the brand text 'Shimano Deore' on the caliper, a common failure point in AI generation.
To ensure the complex geometry of the background spokes does not merge incorrectly with the foreground brake assembly.

focus_areas: Boundary sharpness between caliper and rotor
Structural integrity of thin spokes in background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text 'Shimano Deore'. AI often garbles specific brand logos. Also check if the hydraulic hose connects logically to the caliper port without merging into the casing.
